description: This PHP source file defines the class 'DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor' which extends an abstract matcher processor. It handles logic for duplicating investments with customizable constraints such as maximum amounts, matching factors, and reward considerations within the Goteo fundraising platform. The class includes methods for calculating investment amounts based on various rules, checking reward matches, and limiting investments per user or project.

classes.name: DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that duplicates investments with customizable limits such as maximum amount per invest, per project, per user, and matching rewards. It includes methods to calculate the duplicated investment amount considering existing investments, reward matches, and constraints.

methods.name: getVarLabels
methods.description: Returns an array of labels for each configurable variable used by the processor, fetched via the Text localization class.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a textual description of this matcher processor, useful for documentation or UI display.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duplicated investment amount, considering reward matches if applicable.

methods.name: getAmountMatchingRewards
methods.description: Calculates the amount to be invested when rewards are involved, returning a specific amount if rewards are matched or an error message if no rewards match.

methods.name: getRegularAmount
methods.description: Computes the default investment amount based on various limits, current investments, available funds, and user constraints.
